notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for canceling a pending If Available ownership acquisition during resignation. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies cancellation of the pending request, suppression of stale unavailable or acquisition callbacks, current-owner preservation, and standard cleanup without asserting provider-specific behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador If Available ownership acquisition, pending cancellation, and resignation services with FederateAmbassador ownership callbacks
